artifacts.summary: Empirical verification of all 4 claimed defects (subshell bug, hand-typed line_count, missing index-orphan gate, missing version/generated stamp), full source-level scope (444 entries/19 extensions), and recommended wiring point (check-extension-docs.sh, not validate-context-index.sh or a new verify-deploy.sh gate).

memory_candidates.content: In bash, `jq -r '...' | while IFS=$'\t' read -r ...; do COUNTER=$((COUNTER+1)); done` silently discards COUNTER increments because the while loop runs in a subshell (last pipeline stage). Fix with process substitution (`< <(jq ...)`) or a temp-file/wc -l count. This pattern recurs anywhere a validator accumulates counters inside a piped while-read loop -- check for it specifically when a validator's printed [WARN]/[ERROR] lines don't match its own summary totals.

In this repo's extension system, context/index.json line_count values are hand-typed in each extension's source agent-system/extensions/<ext>/index-entries.json and copied verbatim (no recomputation) by merge.lua's M.append_index_entries during deploy. A regenerator/validator must operate on the SOURCE index-entries.json files (agent-system/extensions/*/), not just the deployed .claude/context/index.json copy, per the source-store/deploy-boundary rule -- fixing only the deployed copy is silently undone on next redeploy.

check-extension-docs.sh has an established, reusable framework for project-wide deployed-file-orphan checks: $EXT_DIR="$REPO_ROOT/agent-system/extensions" iteration, an orphan_report() helper, and an ORPHAN_GATE_MODE advisory-then-hard two-phase promotion precedent (Rules J-Q). New cross-cutting validation checks (e.g. index-vs-disk diffing, line_count drift) should be added as new lettered rules in this file rather than as new verify-deploy.sh gates or standalone scripts, since check-extension-docs.sh is already wired as verify-deploy.sh's gate 3 and inherits its automated invocation for free.
